title: ever REINE|Elegant Double V Neck Velvet Evening Dress with Sleeves
descriptionHtml:
Featuring a double V neckline and ruffles sleeves, this brick-red velvet party dress is your perfect choice for the first event in Fall and Winter! This long velvet v neck party dress with sleeves will show off your timeless elegance. Winter velvet party dress, together with timeless elegance, you will surely feel your best. Brick red velvet party dress is one of the most popular styles for any events this winter. Select yours and be the center of the events.

Fit: Please refer to size chart.

Length: Tea length.

Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.

Closure: It is concealed zipper up the back.

Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.

Fabric: The garment comprises velvet.

Stretch: Fabric is low stretch.
